## Work order (draft)

- Title: Suspected component A feed loss, C header pressure loss, or feed composition variation.
- Priority: High
- Suspected causes: IDV(6), IDV(7), IDV(8)
- Evidence: XMEAS(1) (down), XMV(3) (up), XMEAS(20) (down), XMEAS(29) (down)
- Requested inspection:
    - For IDV(6): Check the stream 1 supply (upstream isolation valves, header pressure, and supplier status), inspect the stream 1 flow transmitter and the feed valve, and verify the stream 1 line for blockage or leakage. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)
    - For IDV(7): Measure the C header pressure at the field gauge, check the supply source and the pressure regulator on the C header, and inspect the stream 4 feed valve and the flow transmitter. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)
    - For IDV(8): Sample the stream 4 feed over time and verify the composition variability, check the feed analyzer and the upstream mixing or blending point, and verify the stream 4 flow transmitter for noise. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)

## Shift handover

L'allarme è iniziato al campione 173. La diagnosi approvata indica come cause sospette una perdita di alimentazione di A (IDV(6)), una perdita di pressione del collettore di C (IDV(7)) o una variazione della composizione dell'alimentazione (IDV(8)). La confidenza è massima (accordo tra i campioni: 1.00). Non sono state segnalate evidenze respinte dal gate. È in attesa l'ispezione di manutenzione per confermare o escludere le cause sospette.

## Work order (draft)

- Title: Suspected C header pressure loss, feed composition variation, or A/C feed ratio change.
- Priority: Medium
- Suspected causes: IDV(7), IDV(8), IDV(1)
- Evidence: XMEAS(23) (down), XMEAS(25) (up), XMEAS(29) (down), XMEAS(31) (up)
- Requested inspection:
    - For IDV(7): Measure the C header pressure at the field gauge, check the supply source and the pressure regulator on the C header, and inspect the stream 4 feed valve and the flow transmitter. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)
    - For IDV(8): Sample the stream 4 feed over time to verify the composition variability, check the feed analyzer and the upstream mixing or blending point, and verify the stream 4 flow transmitter for noise. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)
    - For IDV(1): Check the stream 4 flow measurement and its transmitter calibration, sample the stream 4 feed to verify the A/C ratio against the analyzer reading, and inspect the stream 4 feed control valve and the upstream supply of A and C. (Source: inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md)

## Shift handover

The alarm started at sample index 173. The approved diagnosis points to IDV(7), IDV(8), or IDV(1), with a high agreement (1.00) between samples, although the gate status is PARTIAL. Evidence from XMEAS(1) was rejected by the gate. Maintenance inspection of the C header and stream 4 feed composition/flow is pending.
